description: This file contains utility functions for exporting annotated PGN (Portable Game Notation) in a chess application. It includes functions for formatting PGN headers, sanitizing comments, building move annotations with analysis info, and exporting completed PGN strings. The primary public functions are `exportAnnotatedPgn` for generating annotated PGN content and `downloadPgn` to trigger a browser download of the PGN file.

methods.name: pad2
methods.description: Pads a number with a leading zero if it's a single digit to ensure two-digit formatting.

methods.name: formatPgnDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into PGN date format (YYYY.MM.DD).

methods.name: escapePgnHeaderValue
methods.description: Escapes quotes and backslashes in PGN header values.

methods.name: sanitizeComment
methods.description: Replaces braces with parentheses in comments to ensure PGN compatibility.

methods.name: severityToGlyph
methods.description: Converts severity levels ('inaccuracy', 'mistake', 'blunder') to corresponding glyphs for readability.

methods.name: severityToNag
methods.description: Maps severity levels to standard NAG (Numeric Annotation Glyph) codes.

methods.name: formatEvalForComment
methods.description: Formats evaluation data (mate or centipawns) for inclusion in a move comment.

methods.name: formatPvForComment
methods.description: Formats a principal variation (PV) move list for comment inclusion.

methods.name: buildMoveComment
methods.description: Builds a composite comment string for a move, including severity glyph, evaluation, PV, and loss info.

methods.name: buildMovesSection
methods.description: Converts move history and analysis data into a PGN moves section with inline annotations.

methods.name: exportAnnotatedPgn
methods.description: Generates an annotated PGN string with headers, move annotations, and game result.

methods.name: downloadPgn
methods.description: Triggers a browser download of the PGN string as a file.
